arxiv-2012-06108.title: Fractal dimension and topological invariants as methods to quantify complexity in Yayoi Kusama’s paintings
arxiv-2012-06108.creator: Elsa de la Calleja, Roberto Zenit
arxiv-2012-06108.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Elsa de la Calleja, Roberto Zenit. Intricate patterns in abstract art many times can be wrongly characterized as being complex. Complexity can be an indicator of the internal dynamic of the whole system, regardless of the type of system in question, including art creation. In this investigation, we use two different techniques to objectively quantify complexity in abstract images: the fractal dimension and the value of the Betti numbers.

arxiv-2310-05012.title: Detecting Abnormal Health Conditions in Smart Home Using a Drone
arxiv-2310-05012.creator: Pronob Kumar Barman
arxiv-2310-05012.description: Abstract Nowadays, detecting aberrant health issues is a difficult process. Falling, especially among the elderly, is a severe concern worldwide. Falls can result in deadly consequences, including unconsciousness, internal bleeding, and often times, death. A practical and optimal, smart approach of detecting falling is currently a concern.

arxiv-2405-02636.title: An emergent cosmological model from running Newton constant
arxiv-2405-02636.creator: Aknur Zholdasbek, Hrishikesh Chakrabarty, Daniele Malafarina, Alfio Bonanno
arxiv-2405-02636.description: Abstract We propose an emergent cosmological model rooted in the Asymptotically Safe antiscreening behavior of the Newton constant at Planckian energies. Distinguishing itself from prior approaches, our model encapsulates the variable nature of G G through a multiplicative coupling within the matter Lagrangian, characterized by a conserved energy-momentum tensor.

arxiv-2410-12132.title: Realization of three and four-body interactions between momentum states in a cavity through optical dressing
arxiv-2410-12132.creator: Chengyi Luo, Haoqing Zhang, Chitose Maruko, Eliot A. Bohr, Anjun Chu, Ana Maria Rey, James K. Thompson
arxiv-2410-12132.description: Abstract Paradigmatic spin Hamiltonians in condensed matter and quantum sensing typically utilize pair-wise or 2-body interactions between constituents in the material or ensemble. However, there is growing interest in exploring more general n n -body interactions for n > 2 n>2 , with examples including more efficient quantum gates or the realization of exotic many-body fracton states.

arxiv-2506-01459.title: The effect of measurement uncertainties on the inferred stability of planes of satellite galaxies
arxiv-2506-01459.creator: Prem Kumar, Marcel S. Pawlowski, Kosuke Jamie Kanehisa, Pengfei Li, Mariana P. Júlio, Salvatore Taibi
arxiv-2506-01459.description: Abstract Context. Observations have revealed that the Milky Way, Andromeda, Centaurus A, and possibly other galaxies host spatially thin and kinematically coherent planes of satellites. Such structures are highly improbable within the standard Λ \Lambda CDM cosmological model, and the dynamical stability of these planes has long been debated.

pmc-11333637.title: The development of a new oral health patient reported outcome measure: the New South Wales public dental services approach
pmc-11333637.creator: Rebecca Chen, Shilpi Ajwani, Bradley Christian, Claire Phelan, Ravi Srinivas, Josephine Kenny, Mark O’Connor, Kara Clarke, Woosung Sohn, Albert Yaacoub
pmc-11333637.description: BackgroundAddressing Patient Reported Outcomes (PROs) is essential for patient-centred care, shared decision making and improved health outcomes. Value-based health care systems in New South Wales (NSW) have a growing focus on collecting and using PROs that matter most to patients to improve their healthcare outcomes.

pmc-11397288.title: In Silico Molecular Modeling of Four New Afatinib Derived Molecules Targeting the Inhibition of the Mutated Form of BCR-ABL T315I
pmc-11397288.creator: Kelvyn M L Rocha, Érica C M Nascimento, Rafael C C de Jesus, João B L Martins, Nino Russo
pmc-11397288.description: Four afatinib derivatives were designed and modeled. These derivatives were compared to the known tyrosine-kinase inhibitors in treating Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, i.e., imatinib and ponatinib. The molecules were evaluated through computational methods, including docking studies, the non-covalent interaction index, Electron Localization and Fukui Functions, in silico ADMET analysis, QTAIM, and Heat Map analysis.

pmc-11470394.title: A rare case of fructose-1, 6-bisphosphatase deficiency: Clinical features in a pediatric patient
pmc-11470394.creator: Shami Pokhrel, Subha Sainju, Prasanna Lamsal, Uma Devi Chhetri
pmc-11470394.description: Fructose-1, 6- bisphosphatase deficiency is a rare autosomal recessive inborn error of fructose metabolism which mainly affects gluconeogenesis. It often presents with ketotic hypoglycemia and lactic acidosis, with hyperventilation. The disease has a high mortality rate when undiagnosed.Here we report a case of this rare disorder, referred to our hospital in Western Nepal, diagnosed originally as pneumonia.

pmc-11608104.title: Simultaneous Infrared Observations of the Jovian Auroral Ionosphere and Thermosphere
pmc-11608104.creator: Ruoyan Wang, Tom S. Stallard, Henrik Melin, Kevin H. Baines, Luke Moore, James O’Donoghue, Rosie E. Johnson, Emma M. Thomas, Katie L. Knowles, Paola I. Tiranti, Steve Miller
pmc-11608104.description: Simultaneous observations of H3+ and H2 in Jupiter's northern infrared aurora were conducted on 02 June 2017 using Keck‐NIRSPEC to produce polar projection maps of H3+ radiance, rotational temperature, column density, and H2 radiance. The temperature variations within the auroral region are ∼700−1000 K, generally consistent with previous studies, albeit with some structural differences.

pmc-11651685.title: Acromegaly Disease Control Maintained After Switching From Injected Somatostatin Receptor Ligands to Oral Paltusotine
pmc-11651685.creator: Mônica R Gadelha, Alessandra Casagrande, Christian J Strasburger, Martin Bidlingmaier, Peter J Snyder, Mirtha A Guitelman, Cesar L Boguszewski, Michael Buchfelder, Ilan Shimon, Gerald Raverot, Miklós Tóth, Emese Mezősi, Mirjana Doknic, Xiaolin Fan, David Clemmons, Peter J Trainer, R Scott Struthers,
pmc-11651685.description: ContextPaltusotine is a nonpeptide selective somatostatin receptor 2 agonist in development as once-daily oral treatment for acromegaly.ObjectiveTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of paltusotine in the treatment of patients with acromegaly previously controlled with injected somatostatin receptor ligands (SRLs).MethodsThis phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial enrolled adults with acromegaly who had IGF-I ≤1.

pmc-11653117.title: Daily Physical Activity, Sports Participation, and Executive Function in Children
pmc-11653117.creator: Lu Yang, Eva Corpeleijn, Esther Hartman
pmc-11653117.description: This cohort study investigates associations of physical activity at ages 5 to 6 years and sports participation later in childhood with executive function at ages 10 to 11 years. Introduction Physical activity is well known to benefit physical and mental well-being and to contribute to healthy growth and development in children.

pmc-11690912.title: A LONGITUDINAL INVESTIGATION OF ALCOHOL USAGE AND COGNITIVE OUTCOMES AMONG HISPANIC/LATINO ADULTS
pmc-11690912.creator: Armando Lemus, Carlos Araujo-Menendez, Rubi Carpio, Ariana Stickel
pmc-11690912.description: High alcohol use may lead to cognitive deficits and is recognized as a modifiable risk factor for dementia. However, recent cross-sectional research is contradictory: low to moderate alcohol may be protective against cognitive performance. The present study aimed to investigate the associations between alcohol use and cognitive decline within Hispanic/Latino adults, a community often underrepresented in the research field.

pmc-12490526.title: Non-acute effects of passive heating interventions on cardiometabolic risk and vascular health: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-12490526.creator: Rikuta Hamaya, Yuki Joyama, Tomohiro Miyata, Shun-ichiro Fuse, Naho Yamane, Natsuki Maruyama, Hirofumi Kanazawa, Koki Morishita, Howard D. Sesso
pmc-12490526.description: Highlights•Passive heating, such as hot water bathing and sauna, has been suggested to have cardioprotectic roles in observational studies.•In the systematic review of RCTs investigating the effect of passive heating intervention on cardiometabolic risk and vascular health biomarkers, a potential reduction in SBP was observed with systemic heating and among adults with underlying coronary risk or CVD.

pmc-12649575.title: Assessment of Polymyxin B with Sodium Deoxycholate Sulfate Micelles in a Rat Model to Combat Polymyxin Nephrotoxicity
pmc-12649575.creator: Muhammad Ali Khumaini Mudhar Bintang, Jongdee Nopparat, Teerapol Srichana
pmc-12649575.description: Background/Objectives: Polymyxin B (PMB) was incorporated into a sodium deoxycholate sulfate (SDCS) micelle formulation to mitigate polymyxin-induced nephrotoxicity. This study examined the effect of the formulation on nephrotoxicity and biodistribution in a rat model. Methods: Four groups of rats were subcutaneously administered one of the following: normal saline, SDCS, PMB, or a PMB-SDCS formulation.

pmc-12700478.title: Factors influencing patient satisfaction in postoperative pain management: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12700478.creator: Abhijit S. Nair, Gauhar Afshan, Viktor Kubricht, Sean Chetty, Balavenkatasubramanian Jagannathan
pmc-12700478.description: Background and Aims:Effective postoperative pain management is pivotal not only for alleviating discomfort but also for enhancing overall patient satisfaction and recovery. This systematic review aims to investigate various factors influencing patient satisfaction due to the postoperative pain management offered.Methods:Using relevant keywords, we searched PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane database after registering the protocol in PROSPERO.

pmc-12932121.title: Antisynthetase Syndrome Mimicking Pulmonary Infection: A Diagnostic Lesson From County‐Managed Hospital
pmc-12932121.creator: Jufen Cheng
pmc-12932121.description: Antisynthetase syndrome (ASS) is a rare chronic autoimmune disease classified as a distinct subtype of idiopathic inflammatory myopathy, characterized by the presence of anti–aminoacyl‐transfer RNA synthetase (anti‐ARS) antibodies. Typical clinical features include myositis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), arthritis, fever, mechanic's hands, and Raynaud's phenomenon, with a predominance in middle‐aged to elderly females.

pmc-13022629.title: AKAP2 is required for assembly of cytoskeletal signaling complexes that promote growth and metastasis of triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13022629.creator: Kacey J. Rosenthal, Pamela Felix-Sanchez, Katherine Forbush, Nicole Rhoads, Mingu Kang, Juan Jesus Vicente, F. Donelson Smith, Linda Wordeman, Shao-En Ong, Kevin J. Cheung, John D. Scott
pmc-13022629.description: A Kinase Anchoring Proteins (AKAPs) that coordinate spatiotemporal signaling are increasingly implicated in cancer. Elevated AKAP2 protein correlates with an invasive phenotype in triple-negative breast cancer cell lines. A combination of biochemical, cellular, and omics approaches shows that AKAP2 cytoskeleton and focal adhesion-associated scaffolds contribute to the progression of basal-like triple-negative breast cancer.

pmc-13066485.title: Analysis of chemiluminescence and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry in 25-hydroxyvitamin D detection using fuzzy logic
pmc-13066485.creator: Hongkun Liu, Sirui Li, Kok Wai Wong, Yujie Li, Xinyi He, Shuhao Liang, Hui Deng, Linlin Zhang, Lei Zhang, Jianli Cui
pmc-13066485.description: Vitamin D is an essential nutrient closely associated with the prevention of multiple diseases, including osteoporosis, diabetes, and cardiovascular disorders. The serum level of 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] is the primary biomarker for assessing vitamin D status, and its precise quantification is critical for clinical diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-13556687.description: BackgroundADHD is commonly treated with medications, but residual symptoms and side effects remain a clinical challenge.
